# statusdrift_monitors (Data Source)

Fetches all monitors.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) List of monitors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the monitor.
- `interval` (Number) Check interval in seconds.
- `name` (String) The name of the monitor.
- `status` (String) Current status of the monitor.
- `type` (String) The type of the monitor.
